purpose: Figure 1 FastRelax series with a fixed 50 L-BFGS iterations per minimization, torsion and Cartesian, tmol and PyRosetta

other_settings: unchanged from the 200-step runs: same systems/series/seed, 1 repeat, timing contract (no warm-up, GPU sync)
